name: Nord 2T 5G

images.credit: Rupturestriker, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: Fingerprint (under display, optical), proximity, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 12 with OxygenOS 12.1, Current: Android 14 with OxygenOS 14.1
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x 3.0 GHz Cortex-A78, 3x 2.6 GHz Cortex-A78, 4x 2.0 GHz Cortex-A55)

Display.Display: AMOLED capacitive touchscreen, 6.43 in 1080p, (409 ppi with 20:9 aspect ratio), 90 Hz refresh rate, Gorilla Glass 5, 16M colors, HDR10+/HLG, DCI-P3 support

Cameras.Rear camera: 50 MP Sony IMX766, 24 mm (wide), 1/1.56", 1 μm, PDAF, OIS + 8 MP, 120° (ultrawide) + 2 MP, (depth), Dual-LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60/120/480fps, 720p@30/60/240/960fps, gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: 32 MP Sony IMX615, (wide), 1/2.8", 0.8 μm, Auto-HDR, Video: 1080p@30fps, gyro-EIS

Battery.Charging: 80 W SUPERVOOC fast charging, Power Delivery

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, Bluetooth 5.2 (A2DP, LE, aptX HD), NFC, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6 (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct), GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo, NavIC
